name: Jack Woodruff
bio: Jack Woodruff is the founder and former Chief Investment Officer of Candlestick Capital Management (CCM). Mr. Woodruff led the firm from its inception in 2019 through 2025, overseeing portfolio decisions and building CCM’s investment, research, and risk frameworks. Prior to founding Candlestick, Mr. Woodruff served as a Portfolio Manager in Citadel’s equity unit, Surveyor Capital, from 2010 to 2019, where he built and led an 18-person investment team and invested in more than 400 global equities across multiple sectors. Mr. Woodruff also worked at Sigma Capital, a division of SAC Capital Advisors, and previously held analyst roles at Northsound Capital and Trivium Capital. He began his career at Ernst & Young and maintains an inactive CPA license in California. Mr. Woodruff holds an MBA in Finance from the NYU Stern School of Business and a B.S. in Accounting from the University of Southern California. He currently serves on the University of Southern California Marshall Board of Leaders and Thrive Scholars New York Advisory Board. He also is a Senior Advisor to Connect Ventures and Kepler AI.

sessions.title: AI and the Future of Fundamental Investing
